Implementation and local validation completed.

Editorial attestation

Reviewer: RebarBotNava using joeoakhart@navapbc.com
Reviewed at: 2026-08-23T10:33:30Z
Rows reviewed: 100

Every generated Description cell was compared with its Key, Type, Default, and Lifecycle cells. Each description states a user-visible effect or operational consequence. No description merely restates its type, default, or lifecycle. The review found no unresolved row.

Validation evidence

- The focused description contracts failed in five expected cases before implementation and passed in five cases after implementation.
- D1 passed. The generated configuration reference is current.
- D2 passed with 73 focused tests.
- D3 passed with no new or increased complexity. `_config_schema.py` has 790 lines and `_config_schema_verify.py` has 242 lines. Both are below the 800-line limit.
- D4 passed. Lint completed every repository check, and mypy reported no issues across 641 source files.
- An AST comparison against dbf351c3fea200c665e777bc3ba081ed3ebbc2b0 confirmed unchanged annotations, defaults, and default factories for all 100 typed fields.
- F19A commit 7e2e6afb27026969b86c922285390ba75aa5124b is included in the worktree base. The refreshed plan attestation remains certified at dbf351c3fea200c665e777bc3ba081ed3ebbc2b0.

The implementation changes the five recorded paths only. It adds no prose validator or character restriction.
